objective: Bring 3 Alterac Valley Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

description: Listen up, <name>.  No matter what you might have heard about the battle raging in Alterac Valley, one thing remains true: the Stormpike Expedition invaded Frostwolf Territory.  The day we allow the Alliance to invade Horde lands without a forceful response is the day I hang up my axe and live the rest of my life in shame.  Go forth and expel the invaders!
progress: What news do you bring from the lands of the Frostwolves? How does the battle for Alterac Valley fare?
completion: You've shown great bravery in protecting our lands in Alterac Valley! I will tell my superiors of your deeds.
